title: Cyclic detection of natural isomorphisms on bounded primary groups
statement: Let F,G:Ab→Ab be additive functors preserving colimits of every small filtered diagram, and η:F→G a natural transformation. Let ℓ be prime. Suppose η is invertible on every cyclic group Z/ℓ^s, s≥1 (with universe lifts where necessary). Then for every n≥0 and abelian group M with ℓ^n M=0, η_M is invertible. No finiteness hypothesis on M is imposed.

proof.text: For a finite group A killed by ℓ^n use the finite abelian classification in Mathlib to write A as a finite direct sum of nontrivial Z/d_i. Inject each summand into A; the order of its generator divides ℓ^n. Mathlib Nat.dvd_prime_pow writes d_i=ℓ^s_i, and d_i>1 gives s_i≥1. Additivity preserves the finite biproduct and naturality transports the given component isomorphisms to η_A.

Index by finitely generated additive subgroups of M. Bottom and sums make this a small filtered poset. Every element belongs to the subgroup generated by its singleton; the inclusions form a colimit cocone, checked after the forgetful functor to types. Each subgroup is finitely generated torsion and hence finite by AddCommGroup.finite_of_fg_isAddTorsion. Its component of η is invertible by the previous step. The Mathlib natural-transformation/colimit theorem now gives invertibility at M.

lean.statement:
theorem boundedPrimary_isIso_natTrans
    (F G : AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{u}) [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (η : F ⟶ G) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hcolim : ∀ (I : Type u) [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I],
      PreservesColimitsOfShape I F ∧ PreservesColimitsOfShape I G)
    (hcyclic : ∀ s : ℕ, 1 ≤ s →
      IsIso (η.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod (ℓ ^ s))))))
    (n : ℕ) (M : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (hM : ∀ m : M, (ℓ ^ n) • m = 0) :
    IsIso (η.app M)
